title: Iterative Refinement for a Subset of Eigenvectors of Symmetric Matrices via Matrix Multiplications
summary: We develop an iterative refinement method that improves the accuracy of a user-chosen subset of $k$ eigenvectors ($k\ll n$) of an $n\times n$ real symmetric matrix. Using an orthogonal matrix represented in compact WY form, the method expresses the eigenvector error through a correction matrix that can be approximated efficiently from Rayleigh quotients and residuals.
